content.comment_body: Application example: [product_name] - Modbus RTU communication with [product_name] drive. By using the [product_name] communication module, [product_name] [version_no] provides the capability to control [product_name] drives via serial communication using the Modbus RTU protocol. This entry describes controlling [product_name] drives through the integrated web server of the [product_name] basic module. The drives are connected using RS485 to the serial multiplex interface of the [product_name] communication module. Communication via Modbus RTU occurs sequentially, where the module acts as master and the drives as slaves with individual Modbus addresses. Exchanged data is stored in the communication module and passed to the basic module via [version_no] communication. The module serves as client and the basic module as server. Each drive can be managed through the web server of the basic module by accessing it with a browser on a connected computer. The drive operation involves sending a control word and a setpoint value for motor frequency. The drive provides a status word and the actual frequency as feedback.

analysis.insight_summary: The user outlines the integration and communication workflow between [product_name] communication module and [product_name] drives using Modbus RTU. The central point is the use of [product_name] [version_no]'s integrated web server for direct drive control and structured data exchange via [version_no] communication. The comment details module roles, client-server structure, caching of data, and remote accessibility through a browser.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects reliable, seamless, and real-time control and communication of [product_name] drives via the [product_name] [version_no] platform and web server, with an intuitive process accessible from any standard browser.
